title: please some suggestions or solution for wrong readings
symptom: Using xDrip with MiaoMiao on an international Libre 14-day sensor, reported glucose levels are over 100 points off compared to blood and the Libre scanner. The problem started about two sensors ago, no settings were changed, and calibrations do not keep the readings accurate.
cause: The calibration graph shows points far from the expected straight line; the developer says calibrations should only be done when BG is stable and not right after a meal, and suspects the sensor itself rather than a hardware/software problem.
fix: Calibrate only when BG is stable and not after meals, or install the external OOP algorithm and enable it in xDrip under settings -> less common settings -> other misc options -> out of process blukon algorithm to get readings close to the Libre reader without calibrations. To revert, disable the out of process libre algorithm.
evidence_quote: You need to install something that is called OOP algorithm from: https://drive.google.com/file/d/18zkgZq3ztNlgQZovKcE7ddO70PuawfBB/view?usp=drivesdk and then enable it on xdrip: On xdrip go to setting->less common settings->other misc options-> and set out of process blukon algorithm.
